about_short_description.short_description: Quan is a healthtech company that offers an end-to-end self assesment platform for improving employee wellbeing and team performance.

product.name: Quan Employee Well-Being Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that assesses and improves employee well-being and team performance through quarterly evidence-based assessments and team rituals.

product.name: Quan Well-Being Index
product.description: A validated holistic assessment tool measuring personal and workplace well-being across multiple dimensions to identify well-being strengths and risks.

product.name: Team Well-Being Retro
product.description: A guided quarterly team meeting using aggregated well-being data to discuss team strengths, risks, and improvement actions.

product.name: Targeted Rituals and Interventions
product.description: Recommended science-backed behavioral actions for teams to improve well-being and work practices based on assessment data.

product.name: IKURA AI System
product.description: A community-building cloud service that uses AI technology to help organizations operate and grow online communities.
